v1.2.3b (22 May 2022) |feed_title = Update v1.2.3 |previous_update = [[v1.2.2]] |next_update = [[v1.2.4]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.2.3''' is the thirty-seventh update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 21st of May 2022. It introduced sprinting and a few minor improvements. This version encompassed three updates, the main v1.2.3 update (released 21 May 2022) and two minor updates, the v1.2.3a (released the same day as v1.2.3, 21 May 2022) and v1.2.3b (released 22 May 2022). ==Additions== *Sprinting *Placement highlights ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Optimized network efficiency, reducing lag on slower computers and mobile devices. *Fixed firework from [[Firework]] emote staying forever on the ground, if you stop using the [[Firework]] emote while your character lights it. *Fixed [[Golden Body Guards 1]] name being ''GoldenGuard2'' in-game instead of ''Body Guards''. *Fixed [[Body Guard]] and [[Golden Body Guard]] names being ''Body Guards'' instead of ''Body Guard''. *Corrected multiple tower descriptions. **[[Cowboy]]'s description now says that it generates cash every fifth shot instead of eight. **[[Militant]]'s description no longer mentions its removed reloading mechanic. **[[Ranger]]'s description no longer mentions that it uses a railgun. :In '''v1.2.3a''': *Ground placement spots are no longer highlighted. *Fixed [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] not moving until its ''Void Rage'' ability is activated. *Fixed [[Templar]] never stopping firing its minigun after its ''Minigun'' ability was activated. *Fixed [[P3NGU (D00M's Revenge)|P3NGU]] never stopping firing its beam after its ''Beak-A-Beam'' ability was activated. :In '''v1.2.3b''': *Fixed towers that use hitboxes being able to damage units. *Fixed being able to collide with [[Golden Body Guards 1]]'s briefcase. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Duck Hunt 2022 icon.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's in-game update log.
